verdict_reason: A copied v3 suite with a title that still says v0.3.0, an over-claiming 'All' title, and comment banners.

todos.issue: Two titles do not match their assertions. map_shouldStampV030SchemaVersionAndUriAndKeepTheIncomingCorrelationId (line 61) asserts schemaVersion '0.4.0' and the v0.4.0 schema URI; the title was copied from the v3 test. map_shouldPassThroughAllEnvelopeFields (line 44) asserts seven fields, but PimsEventV4 also carries metadata, actor and statusChanges, so 'All' over-claims. The v3 original said 'IdentityFields'.
todos.fix: Must: each title states what its assertions prove. One way: map_shouldStampV040SchemaVersionAndUriAndKeepTheIncomingCorrelationId and map_shouldPassThroughEnvelopeIdentityFields.

todos.issue: PimsEventMapperV4Test is PimsEventMapperV3Test copied. Apart from type names and the 0.4.0 metadata values, the only changes are dropping the v3 issuer assertion, two title edits and a new '// --- Helpers ---' banner. The mapper graph in its field initialiser (lines 24-36) is also built by hand again, as it is in PimsPayloadMapperTest and NotificationSqsListenerTest.
todos.fix: Must: event-mapping behaviour shared by v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 is tested once; this class tests only what is specific to v0.4.0 (its metadata) and gets its mapper from a shared test helper. One way: keep only the metadata test here and build the mapper through the shared PimsPayloadMapper test factory raised on NotificationSqsListenerTest.

todos.issue: The new file brings in '// Given', '// When', '// Then' and '// When / Then' comments (lines 97, 106, 109, 122, 127, 134, 145) and a '// --- Helpers ---' section banner (line 157).
todos.fix: Must: no Given/When/Then comments and no section banners in the file. One way: delete them and separate set-up, action and assertions with blank lines.
